categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Toua Hardware & Tools Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: power tools and architectural hardware products. The power tools segment focuses on gas-powered nail guns, pneumatic nail guns, lithium battery nail guns, electric hammers, and drills. The architectural hardware segment includes high-end products such as ventilation outlets, inspection ports, and floor supports, mainly customized for the Japanese market.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered core technologies in gas-powered nail gun production, breaking foreign technical barriers, and has contributed to industry standards. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including stamping, die casting, injection molding, and surface treatment for hardware products. The company integrates mechatronics, brushless motor control, lithium battery management systems, and embedded algorithms in its power tools, supported by flexible production management systems and ERP, CRM, PLM, and OA information platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include European well-known hardware brands such as Stanley Black & Decker, GNGROUP, TIMCO, Rawlplug, and HIKOKI, mainly for ODM sales of power tools and consumables. The architectural hardware products are primarily exported to Japan, serving major building material supermarkets and large construction companies like Konan, Komeri, Viva Home, Tokken, Haseko, and Panasonic Homes. The domestic market focuses on professional and renovation users in construction, industrial manufacturing, and landscaping.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with manufacturing bases in Jiangning, Bowang, and Haimen. Its sales cover domestic markets and international markets, with significant exports to Europe and Japan. The overseas markets include the Belt and Road countries and developed European countries, with a focus on high-end ODM exports to Europe and architectural hardware exports to Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing Toua operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of power tools and architectural hardware products. It controls core manufacturing processes and has integrated supply chain capabilities including raw material procurement, in-house production, and direct sales or ODM partnerships with end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment to maintain technological leadership, focusing on new energy-driven fastening technologies, high-energy lithium battery nail guns, pneumatic tools, and garden electric tools. It aims to build a comprehensive R&D system with enhanced product management and project management, integrating sustainable development and market orientation. The company also plans to upgrade production efficiency and expand product lines to cover all categories of power tools.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of power tools, consumables (nails, gas canisters), and architectural hardware products. Sales channels include direct sales, ODM contracts with international brands, and buyout distribution networks domestically. The company also develops e-commerce channels domestically and internationally to capture consumer markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the gas-powered nail gun segment and a major international manufacturer in the fastening tool industry. It competes with global brands like ITW, Hilti, Stanley Black & Decker, and HIKOKI. In architectural hardware, it is a competitive integrated supplier in Japan, serving major retail chains and construction companies. The company leverages its technological advantages and brand reputation to maintain a strong market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 606.6 million, a 31.14% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 10.39 million, up 118.09%. Total assets were about RMB 1.06 billion, with a slight decrease from the previous year, and net assets increased by 3.75% to RMB 603.44 million. The company has shown steady growth with expanding production and sales volumes, especially after acquiring a controlling stake in Tengya Iron Anchor.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced core technologies in gas-powered nail guns, breaking foreign monopolies, and establishing industry standards. It offers a broad product portfolio with high customization capabilities, especially for the Japanese architectural hardware market. Its flexible production system, strong R&D capabilities, and mature marketing network enable rapid response to customer needs and high-quality products. The company’s brand is recognized domestically and internationally for reliability, innovation, and comprehensive integrated supply solutions.
